Hey, you guys look worn out!\nWe'll reach Draco Town soon, so hang in there!
Whoa~, it's looks like the sky has a ceiling...\nI've never seen anything like this before.
What you see up there is a huge rock mass in\nMovere forest. We're now above a smaller rock mass\nconnected by a large rock pillar in the forest.
This rock mass has a mysterious propulsion system\nthat enables it to move freely, you know?
I thought the forest was drifting naturally,\nso that was not the case?!
Of course not, it'd collide with the rock masses\naround it if it was like that. It's moving while\nslightly adjusting the angle to avoid collisions.
T-the more I listen to your story, the more\nridiculous it gets. It's too much for my brain...
By the way, he said that the power that propels\nthis place is coming from a vital point of\nthe weredragons. You wonder what exactly it is...
A vital point of the weredragons?\nOh, it's that thing...
What's that?
Is it something special?
Umm...it's hard to explain.\nLet's just go now and ask the chieftain grandpa.\nC'mon!
W-what's that?!
A-a Golemm?!
Cool right? This place is like a gateway to\nDraco Town. Dragons and Coenubias come here too,\nso this guy was created to guard and defend it.
Wow~...Amazing.\nI can't believe that someone is able to create\nsomething like this...
Huh?
Hmph, I was the one who created this thing!
No wayy!!
Hey, you think weredragons are like primitives?\nWe have learned and used various technologies in\nyour world before. This is nothing.
I made this thing almost as powerful as the\nadventurer who protected Drafbourg, a town in the\nhuman world. Do you wanna try fighting it?
Okay, I forgot you're tired now.\nSorry.
Anyway, can we just go to the town quickly?\nI'm tired too.
Ok, ok, I'll take you there now...Well, just come\nhere when you feel like fighting it. It's always\nready, when there are no intruders, of course.
Alright, make sure you guard this place well, ok?
It has been a few days since you escorted Zianga\nand the three homunculi to Draco Town...
Haaa...We should be heading back to\nErva Tronc soon.
Aye...
Hmm?
Stop making it difficult for us!\nGive us that parcel you're holding now!
No way! The village chief told me to keep it.\nI can't let you have it!!
Whaat?!
Big guys like you shouldn't do that to a kid!
Who the heck are ya?\nJust stay out of this, shorties...
Aarghh! Y-you stupid shorties!!
D-darn it! We won't forget this!!
I used to live in a village called Boma Konda, but\nthe weredragons of the Imperial Dragon faction\ncame to attack and occupy it...
What the...
Why were they going after you?
The village chief gave this to me...\nHe said it's the guardian deity of the village...
So those weredragons were after it...\nFirst, we need to save Boma Konda!
Anono, take him to Draco Town and tell everyone\nto be prepared for the attack of the weredragons\nof the Imperial Dragon faction.
We'll go to his village to liberate it!
Aye! I got it!!
Aye, follow me!
Here, use it when helping the chief and everyone\nin the village...
